tactics:
induction x with
  | nil => intro bs; exact hnil bs
  | cons a as ih => intro bs; exact hcons a as bs (fun bs' => ih (bs' :: bs))

induction x with
  | nil => intro bs; simpa [List.flatMapM.loop] using hnil bs
  | cons a as ih => intro bs; simpa [List.flatMapM.loop] using hcons a as bs (fun bs' => ih (bs' :: bs))
